gloss: to cut, to sever, to turn off

definitions.gloss: to cut, to sever, to slice
definitions.explanation: To divide something with a sharp instrument.
To stop the operation of a device or end a connection.
To terminate a relationship or connection.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}を{小|ちい}さく{切|き}る。
examples.english: To cut vegetables into small pieces.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{切|き}りに{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go get a haircut.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{台所|だいどころ}で{魚|さかな}を{三|みっ}つに{切|き}って、{私|わたし}と{兄|あに}に{分|わ}けてくれた。
examples.english: My mother cut the fish into three pieces in the kitchen and shared it with me and my older brother.

examples.japanese: テレビを{切|き}ってください。
{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{電気|でんき}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: To turn off the lights before sleeping.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{終|お}わったら、{電話|でんわ}を{切|き}って、{部屋|へや}の{電気|でんき}も{切|き}った。
examples.english: When the meeting ended, I hung up the phone and also turned off the lights in the room.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{話|はなし}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: To stop talking to a friend.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}との{関係|かんけい}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I broke off the relationship with him.

examples.japanese: {悪|わる}い{友達|ともだち}との{関係|かんけい}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: To cut ties with a bad friend.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{仕事|しごと}との{関係|かんけい}を{切|き}った。
examples.english: I cut ties with my old job.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}と{長|なが}い{間|あいだ}{話|はな}さなかったが、{関係|かんけい}を{切|き}ったわけではなかった。
examples.english: I hadn't talked with my family for a long time, but that didn't mean I had cut off relations.

notes:
{切|き}る is a fundamental verb with many uses.

TRANSITIVITY:
- 他動詞 (transitive)
- Pair: {切|き}れる (intransitive, to be cut, to run out)

CONJUGATION (godan, r-column):
- ない形: 切らない
- ます形: 切ります
- て形: 切って
- た形: 切った
- 可能形: 切れる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{切|き}る (to cut something)
- {電話|でんわ}を{切|き}る (to hang up the phone)
- {電源|でんげん}を{切|き}る (to turn off the power)
- {縁|えん}を{切|き}る (to cut ties)
- {期限|きげん}が{切|き}れる (deadline expires - intransitive pair)

COMPOUND VERBS:
- {切|き}り{取|と}る (to cut off, to clip out)
- {切|き}り{開|ひら}く (to clear, to pioneer)
- {切|き}り{捨|す}てる (to discard, to truncate)
- {切|き}り{替|か}える (to switch, to change over)
- {思|おも}い{切|き}る (to give up, to resign oneself)

IDIOMS:
- {息|いき}を{切|き}らす (to be out of breath)
- {腹|はら}を{切|き}る (to commit seppuku; to take responsibility)
- {痛|いた}みを{切|き}る (to feel sharp pain)
